task.horizon_rationale: 102400 is exactly divisible by both the PPO rollout of 2048 and the RTU-PPO rollout of 128.

metric.name: fov_last_10pct_ema_auc
metric.source: raw per-transition rewards from each upstream NPZ archive

selection_rule.per_seed_statistic: fov_last_10pct_ema_auc recomputed from the raw reward trace
selection_rule.aggregate_statistic: arithmetic mean over the exact two open development seeds
selection_rule.tie_break: configuration path ascending by Unicode code point
selection_rule.if_fewer_than_three_are_eligible: advance every eligible candidate and do not substitute, retune, or rerun after inspecting rewards
required_eligibility_checks: exact seed set and no extra runs
PPO rollout_steps multiplied by explicit num_updates equals 102400
selection_rule.scope: Operational triage for a later, separately declared open-development run only; ranking is not evidence of superiority.

common_derivation.unchanged: All selected algorithm, representation, optimizer, replay, target, exploration, rollout, epoch, and minibatch hyperparameters remain those of the named fixed upstream evaluation template unless a departure is enumerated below.
departures: Replace the upstream environment ID with ForagaxTwoBiomeLarge-v1.
Force observation_type to color; this changes the R1 PPO templates from rgb to color.
Replace the 10000000-step upstream evaluation horizon with the common 102400-step development horizon.
Use open run indices 2000001 and 2000002 with the retained zero seed offset.
Add explicit PPO num_updates values of 50 and 800 so upstream's fallback floor-division-plus-one path cannot overshoot the horizon.

Create each plain-DQN paired control by retaining its intervention template's architecture and all non-intervention settings while changing the dispatch to DQN and deleting only intervention-specific fields.
common_derivation.diagnostics: The R1 PPO template diagnostics at cadence 100000 and x_ref_steps 100 are retained in the frozen full-run configs. They are disabled only by the one-transition smoke scheduler because no diagnostic claim is tested there.

The X33 DRQN and X34 PT-DQN fixed Git blobs encode these values.

Delete pm_buffer_size, pt_decay, pt_optimizer, and pt_update_freq.
Change agent from DQN_ReDo_PostLNScore to DQN.
Delete redo_freq, redo_reset_layernorm, redo_score_after_ln, and redo_threshold.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: Off-policy DQN, replay size 1000, batch 32, update frequency 4, target refresh 128, ForagerNet with pre=1/core=0/post=1 and post-activation LayerNorm.
compute_and_state_contracts.difference: ReDo scores post-LayerNorm dormancy and may recycle units every 2500 gradient updates, corresponding to 10000 environment steps and 10 scheduled intervention points in this horizon; the paired control has no intervention state.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: Off-policy DQN, replay size 1000, batch 32, update frequency 4, target refresh 128, ForagerNet with two width-32 hidden layers and LayerNorm.
compute_and_state_contracts.difference: PT_DQN adds separate permanent and transient networks, a 10000-entry permanent-memory buffer, a permanent SGD optimizer, transient decay 0.95, and periodic permanent updates every 2500 transient updates; the paired control has one online network plus its target and no permanent-memory state.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: Current audit-checkout XFinal off-policy recurrent DQN: replay size 1000, batch 32, epsilon 0.25, Adam alpha 0.0001, update frequency 4, and target refresh 128.
compute_and_state_contracts.difference: Each replay sample carries a 32-step sequence and recurrent state; the first 16 steps are burn-in. The online policy carries a 64-unit GRU state.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: Published-v1/Table-6-compatible X33 off-policy recurrent DQN: replay size 1000, batch 4, epsilon 0.1, Adam alpha 0.001, update frequency 4, and target refresh 128.
compute_and_state_contracts.difference: Each replay sample carries the published 32-step sequence and recurrent state; the first 16 steps are burn-in. The online policy carries the same 64-unit GRU architecture as the current-XFinal variant, but optimizer, exploration, and batch settings are intentionally distinct.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: Feedforward PPO with separate actor/critic towers, ReLU, no LayerNorm, rollout 2048, 50 rollouts, 4 epochs, and 32 minibatches per epoch.
compute_and_state_contracts.persistent_causal_state: Previous action and reward are passed by the runner; there is no recurrent hidden state.

compute_and_state_contracts.common: RTU-PPO with separate recurrent actor/critic towers, ReLU, LayerNorm, rollout 128, 800 rollouts, 4 epochs, and one full-rollout minibatch per epoch.
compute_and_state_contracts.persistent_causal_state: Previous action and reward plus separate actor/critic RTU hidden state.

source_selection_rule.basis: Hash the exact upstream entrypoints plus local modules imported by the selected problem and eight algorithm dispatches, and hash the environment lock files. Template blobs are bound separately above.
inclusions: experiment loading and base problem plumbing
Foragax problem, environment, and problem registry
DQN, ReDo, DRQN, PT-DQN, feedforward PPO, and RTU-PPO implementations
shared representation, activation, RTU, optimizer, and RL-Glue modules
source_selection_rule.exclusions: Unselected agents, plotting, collectors, unrelated experiment templates, generated files, caches, and results are outside this protocol source list.
source_selection_rule.validation: Every listed checkout hash must equal both Git commit 9710f60fa30da5badc451ad7ce3ff296d5070830 and the file copied into the exact development image before execution.

limitations_and_nonqualification: Seeds 2000001 and 2000002 are open, consumed development seeds; they are not held out.
Two seeds and a 102400-step prefix cannot support inferential, official, causal, SOTA, or promotion claims.
The fixed upstream templates were selected on different SquareWave tasks and were not retuned for ForagaxTwoBiomeLarge-v1 color observations.

The published-v1 X33 DRQN and the current-audit-checkout XFinal DRQN are separate candidates: neither is a substitute for the other, and their optimizer, exploration, and minibatch settings differ materially.
The derived configurations are not immutable upstream Git blobs; every transformation is disclosed and hash-bound here.
Candidate compute, replay, optimizer, parameter, and persistent-state budgets are materially different, so the operational ranking is not a controlled architecture or memory ablation.
The PPO templates retain diagnostic work near 100000 steps while the other templates do not, creating additional compute asymmetry.
The development image is not an independently qualified production image and defaults to NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 outside the explicit CPU smoke overrides.

The two-lane CPU smoke proves configuration loading, dispatch, construction, one transition per lane, and saving only; it does not test full-horizon learning, reward performance, determinism, or GPU behavior.

The PPO smoke replaces only rollout_steps, num_mini_batch, num_updates, frame allocation, and diagnostics after validating the frozen full-run values; those smoke scheduler values are not screening configurations.
Upstream raw reward archive dtypes may differ across entrypoints; scoring hashes each raw trace and converts values to float64 only for the declared metric calculation.
No full screening reward run was executed while creating this protocol.
